// Devflow's Playwright config, written by devpit's setup: the specs Devflow
// writes in .devpit/devflow/e2e, with a JUnit report and every screenshot and video
// kept in $DEVPIT_REPORT_DIR as the run's evidence. It is yours to change:
// a setup run again keeps your copy. Run it from the project's root.
import { defineConfig } from '@playwright/test'
import base from '../../playwright.config'

const root = process.cwd()
const reports = process.env.DEVPIT_REPORT_DIR ?? `${root}/.devpit/devflow/runs/local`

export default defineConfig({
  ...base,
  testDir: `${root}/.devpit/devflow/e2e`,
  testMatch: '**/*.spec.ts',
  outputDir: `${reports}/test-results`,
  reporter: [['list'], ['junit', { outputFile: `${reports}/report.xml` }]],
  use: { ...base.use, screenshot: 'on', video: 'on' },
  // The project's server starts from its root, not from this folder.
  ...(base.webServer
    ? { webServer: [base.webServer].flat().map((server) => ({ cwd: root, ...server })) }
    : {}),
})
